metadata.name: Synapse Complete System Architecture
metadata.description: Accessible React/Electron lecture application, FastAPI coordination, detection-first multimodal processing, staged explanation preparation, configurable inference and local persistence.
metadata.verificationStatus: static_source_inspection_only; runtime, deployment and effective environment configuration unverified
metadata.statusSemantics: implemented describes connected code, not successful execution. partial describes limited or incomplete capability. code_supported edges are statically traced, never live-verified.
metadata.layoutSemantics: Use groupId for boundaries and directed edges for layout. Flows are subgraphs; edgeIds are not necessarily a single sequential list. Alternative paths and parallel branches must remain distinct.
metadata.animationSemantics: Logical illustration of source-supported paths only; not runtime telemetry. No technical durations are supplied. Conditional phases require their trigger; skipped phases bypass to the appropriate next stage.
metadata.gesturePolicy: Gesture/interaction-cue analysis is an embedded optional capability of frame and visual processing, not an independently drawn module or service. Preserve its partial status and possible fusion into synchronization in descriptions and evidence; do not animate unverified gesture cues as confirmed operational data flow.

groups.label: Frontend Application
groups.description: React browser UI with optional Electron host.

groups.label: Backend and Coordination
groups.description: FastAPI, owned user operations and durable background work.

groups.label: Multimodal Processing
groups.description: Major processing responsibilities executed by the backend and its workers; not independent deployed microservices.

groups.label: AI Inference Boundaries
groups.description: Configured remote endpoints, local model services and persistent model subprocesses.

groups.label: Data Storage
groups.description: Local-default SQL persistence and managed filesystem artifacts.

groups.label: External Video Services
groups.description: YouTube lecture playback and media/caption/metadata acquisition.

nodes.label: Learner
nodes.description: Loads lectures, requests explanations, listens and reviews.

nodes.label: Accessible Application
nodes.description: React state-driven navigation, lecture/search, explanation, library, bookmarks, notes, Help and gated Quiz screens; keyboard and voice handlers share application actions.

nodes.label: Electron Host
nodes.description: Optional desktop container with isolated renderer, explicit permissions and a packaged loopback static frontend server. Does not prove that the backend is packaged or launched with it.

nodes.label: Lecture Player
nodes.description: YouTube IFrame player with seeking and pause ownership; independent explanation audio and first-explanation startup readiness gate.

nodes.label: Voice Interaction
nodes.description: Microphone turns, command context, clarification and spoken/live-region feedback; shared audio arbitration.

nodes.label: Browser State and Preferences
nodes.description: Local/session storage adapters and IndexedDB-backed recovery/attempt storage; preferences and account-token restoration, separate from canonical backend lecture data.

nodes.label: FastAPI API
nodes.description: Validates requests, serves shared lecture/preparation results and audio, mounts private account/history/request routes and separate voice/Ask/Quiz workflows.

nodes.label: Accounts and Personal Learning Data
nodes.description: Loopback-local accounts, bearer session authorization and owner-scoped history, saved explanations, library, playback and voice-note media.

nodes.label: Video Processing Jobs
nodes.description: Persistent per-video job admission/join, lease ownership, retry/cancel/resume, detection invocation and context persistence.

nodes.label: Explanation Preparation
nodes.description: Durable evidence, text and CPU speech stages with bounded handoffs, priority, checkpoints, ownership fencing and recovery. Different items can occupy different stages concurrently.

nodes.label: On-Demand Requests
nodes.description: Owner-scoped operation identity, active lecture interest/heartbeat, requested timestamps, prioritization and review progress around shared preparation.

nodes.label: Lecture Q&A and Quiz
nodes.description: Separate transcript-grounded Ask and screened quiz generation; sources derive from backend transcript times. Quiz availability is gated separately on frontend and backend.

nodes.label: Video Ingestion
nodes.description: Validates YouTube identity and establishes lecture artifact context before extraction; cache hits can bypass fresh detection.

nodes.label: Audio and Transcription
nodes.description: YouTube captions first; audio/Whisper fallback in a persistent subprocess produces timestamped transcript records.

nodes.label: Frame and Visual Feature Analysis
nodes.description: Extracts representative lecture images and educational category/complexity metadata using FFmpeg, OpenCV and CLIP. Optional gesture/interaction-cue analysis is integrated as a partial capability of multimodal visual processing, not a standalone service.

capabilities.label: Gesture Detection / Instructor Interaction Cues
capabilities.description: Optional gesture/interaction analysis within the multimodal processing path; interactions may contribute to synchronization when enabled. Hand detection is disabled in the inspected orchestrator configuration; accurate interpretation/association is unverified.

nodes.label: Multimodal Synchronization
nodes.description: Associates transcript and keyframes to intervention moments; may optionally incorporate gesture/interaction episodes from visual processing. Does not require successful gesture extraction.

nodes.label: Visual Understanding
nodes.description: Per-intervention image analysis through the selected VLM adapter; reusable evidence snapshots and conditional focused readings.

nodes.label: Structured Evidence and Context
nodes.description: Canonical visual evidence assembly/validation, timestamp-aligned speech and deterministic coverage planning for grounded explanation inputs.

nodes.label: Explanation Generation
nodes.description: Builds bounded evidence/context inputs for brief, explanatory and detailed text; checks completed responses and checkpoints text before speech. Explicit transcript-only targets remain distinct from visual explanations.

nodes.label: Explanation Text-to-Speech
nodes.description: Shared local CPU Pocket TTS primary and Kokoro fallback produce explanation audio, with attempt-scoped PCM streaming and completed MP3 artifacts.

nodes.label: VLM Inference
nodes.description: Default adapter targets Qwen/Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct-FP8 on authenticated Modal/vLLM. A separately selected local Qwen2-VL GGUF path also exists; it is not automatic failover from Modal.

nodes.label: Explanation LLM
nodes.description: Code default: local Ollama mistral:latest. Explicit alternatives: Modal Ministral-3-14B-Instruct-2512 or Gemini. These are mutually selected providers, not a chain of models.

nodes.label: Voice Recognition and Replies
nodes.description: Persistent CPU faster-whisper and multilingual MiniLM command interpretation plus separate local Piper spoken replies. Distinct from explanation TTS.

nodes.label: Q&A / Quiz Text Provider
nodes.description: Independent text-provider selection defaults to Gemini; optional retrieval/reranking/faithfulness models are code-gated capabilities within the Q&A subsystem.

nodes.label: SQL Persistence
nodes.description: SQLAlchemy with repository-local SQLite by default; shared videos/transcripts/interventions/explanation metadata/jobs and owner-scoped sessions/requests/history/saves. Configurable database URL does not establish another deployed database.

nodes.label: Artifacts and Managed Media
nodes.description: Local frames, transcript/evidence JSON, text and MP3 checkpoints, versioned cache manifests, stream journals, saved media and voice recordings. Atomic temporary writes and managed cleanup are implemented.

nodes.label: YouTube Services
nodes.description: External source for embedded playback, search/metadata, captions and media acquisition. Backend extraction is distinct from browser playback.

flows.label: Prepare Lecture Context
flows.description: Validate video, fork transcription and keyframe analysis, join, select intervention moments, persist and queue preparation. Optional gesture/interaction-cue analysis is an embedded partial capability of visual processing and may conditionally inform synchronization; it is not independently animated.
flows.trigger: Valid new lecture or invalid context cache

flows.label: Prepare Visual Explanation
flows.description: Evidence worker calls selected VLM, validates canonical evidence, aligns transcript and hands off to explanation generation. Current evidence cache can skip VLM.
conditions: Unusable visual evidence prevents a strict visual explanation.
Only the selected inference provider executes.
Different interventions may occupy evidence, text and speech stages concurrently.

flows.label: Learner-Requested Explanation
flows.description: Authenticated request with active lecture session links private intent to shared preparation. Initial lecture processing must already exist; requests can wait for its context-ready callback or resume an existing cancelled job. Requested timestamp may require fresh frame acquisition.
flows.trigger: Explanation request or retry within an owned lecture session

flows.label: Deliver Explanation Text and Speech
flows.description: Checkpoint text, synthesize speech, publish current artifacts and respond with status/text, completed audio or current-attempt NDJSON. Frontend media guards control playback.
flows.trigger: Completed text and audio generation or validated reusable artifacts
deliveryAlternatives: current audio attempt through NDJSON PCM stream

flows.label: Reuse Current Checkpoints
flows.description: Context, visual evidence, text and completed text/audio caches have different validation gates. Reuse resumes at the owning stage rather than declaring every cache hit complete.

flows.label: Voice Command and Reply
flows.description: Capture a user turn, transcribe, interpret with screen context, apply permitted action and deliver a separate Piper/browser/live-region reply.
flows.trigger: Voice feature enabled and microphone turn explicitly requested

flows.label: Account and Saved Learning Data
flows.description: Local authenticated requests access owner-scoped records and saved media; browser recovery/preferences remain a separate persistence scope.

flows.label: Separate Lecture Q&A / Quiz
flows.description: Load transcript and optional moment evidence, conditionally call independent text provider, validate/screen and return answer sources or quiz. This does not force the main visual explanation pipeline to rerun.
flows.trigger: Ask request or Quiz enabled on both sides and requested
conditions: Insufficient context can return without model generation.
Quiz screening does not establish educational correctness.

flows.label: Independent Lecture Playback
flows.description: Optional Electron hosts frontend; application controls embedded YouTube player while the lecture stream comes directly from YouTube. Startup explanation readiness and media guards affect playback.
flows.trigger: Lecture screen opened and learner playback allowed

animationPhases.label: Open Application and Lecture
animationPhases.description: Show frontend, optional Electron host and independent YouTube player. User submits video selection through the API.
animationPhases.trigger: Application and lecture opened; Electron edge only for desktop runtime

animationPhases.label: Admit Context Processing
animationPhases.description: Join/create durable video job and invoke detection-only processing on a context cache miss.
animationPhases.trigger: Valid input and no reusable context

animationPhases.label: Extract Speech and Visual Context
animationPhases.description: Animate two extraction branches concurrently. Caption success skips Whisper; caption failure uses its audio fallback. Gesture scan is not a mandatory parallel stream.

animationPhases.label: Synchronize and Persist Lecture Context
animationPhases.description: Merge completed extraction, identify moments, persist shared lecture context and schedule explanation modes. Optional gesture/interaction analysis is documented within visual processing but is not a separate animated node or confirmed-flow pathway.

animationPhases.label: Prioritize Learner Request
animationPhases.description: An owned active lecture session links an on-demand request to shared work. Initial processing must already exist; the request may resume its cancelled job or await context, enter visual preparation, or take the explicitly transcript-only alternative.
animationPhases.trigger: Authenticated learner requests explanation or retry after initial lecture processing has started

animationPhases.label: Understand the Selected Visual
animationPhases.description: Selected VLM analyzes the image; usable canonical evidence moves through a checkpoint/handoff. Failed extraction must not continue as a successful visual explanation.
animationPhases.trigger: Visual target, no reusable evidence, provider ready and extraction usable

animationPhases.label: Ground and Generate Explanation
animationPhases.description: Combine evidence with aligned saved speech and coverage; selected LLM returns completed text. Do not activate multiple alternative explanation providers together.
animationPhases.trigger: Usable evidence or reused snapshot; matching text checkpoint absent

animationPhases.label: Use Explicit Transcript Context
animationPhases.description: Requested frame unavailable or target explicitly transcript-only: use saved speech without claiming visual analysis. Ordinary failed visual requests do not automatically take this branch.
animationPhases.trigger: Explicit transcript evidence kind and nonempty transcript context

animationPhases.label: Synthesize Explanation Audio
animationPhases.description: Text checkpoint enters CPU speech. Across different interventions the evidence, text and speech stages can overlap; per-item stage dependency remains ordered.
animationPhases.trigger: Completed or reusable text; missing/invalid audio
animationPhases.overlapScope: different preparation items in different stages

animationPhases.label: Reuse Valid Context or Checkpoints
animationPhases.description: Choose the relevant cache level: context reuse schedules preparation; evidence reuse resumes text; text reuse resumes speech; complete text/audio reuse goes to delivery.
animationPhases.trigger: Cache is current, compatible and validated

animationPhases.label: Deliver Accessible Explanation
animationPhases.description: Retrieve JSON and completed audio, or subscribe to current-attempt PCM NDJSON. Frontend displays text and plays audio only under valid media/conversation guards.
animationPhases.trigger: Current stream attempt or complete validated explanation available

animationPhases.label: Handle Optional Voice Turn
animationPhases.description: Voice recognition/interpretation and Piper reply use their own local path; actions then reuse existing application behavior.
animationPhases.trigger: Enabled voice feature and explicit microphone turn

animationPhases.label: Access Owned Learning Data
animationPhases.description: Apply local account authorization before accessing personal database/media records; browser recovery and preferences are a separate store.

animationPhases.label: Answer or Generate Practice
animationPhases.description: Use available lecture evidence, optional independent provider generation, validation/screening and API delivery. Quiz has separate client/server gates.
animationPhases.trigger: Ask or permitted Quiz request; model edges only when generation needed
